mapper.sql: FROM dish d INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id WHERE d.id = #{dishId} AND d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') AND m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status = 'OPEN' AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND c.status = 'OPEN'
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.merchant_id AS merchantId, d.name AS dishName
LIMIT 1
